representation.name: Semantic Portal Presence Field
representation.change_from_pb5: An independently trained background/door per-pixel field replaces vertical-line and paired-handle score heuristics as the portal-presence authority.
representation.candidate_rule: Raw eight-connected door-class components ranked by predicted door-pixel area; no morphology, prompt, crop, TTA, target identity, or ensemble.
representation.selection_interpretation: At 1280 by 960 this is 35 predicted door pixels; the fraction, not a fixed pixel count, is frozen for confirmation.

development.positive_source: Six source-disjoint portal-lattice-fresh-v3 glass-door frames with pre-existing portal-set boxes.
development.negative_source: Sixteen target-local-v1 frames frozen as containing no distinct actionable entrance before that route's model call.
development.gate: positive truth retention at least 4/6 and no-portal false authorization at most 2/16

integrity.first_launch: Stopped before model inference because the installed Ultralytics version differed from the historical provider pin.
integrity.mechanical_repair: Froze the already installed and model-compatible Ultralytics 8.4.102; no package upgrade, model change, source change, or output-dependent change was made.

next_step: Freeze the selected normalized area threshold and test one source-disjoint PB6 cohort. SCIL must independently prove the requested entity; SPPF must admit door presence; the unchanged portal proposer must retain the human portal set at Top-3. Include no-portal and open-aperture OOD controls and forbid COMMIT or guidance.
claim_boundary: Algorithm-fresh Development evidence on consumed public-image cohorts. The result justifies a source-disjoint confirmation of semantic presence-gated portal proposals. It is not identity, portal ownership, public access, opening state, traversability, active-view causality, temporal persistence, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety evidence.
